simple.meaning: תַּעֲלֻמָּה (taʻălummâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a secret.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Job, Psalms, beginning at Job 11:6. Its contexts include death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּעֲלֻמָּה (H8587).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
